summary: An easy, friendly start with a real fight for the last slot: nine big names, then Kazakhstan hiding at #10 while Romania and the Netherlands sit just below.
reasons: Nine of the ten are household names; a casual player gets them in about ten guesses
The tension is all in #10: Kazakhstan, which the prompt fairly flags with 'transcontinental countries included'
Misses are true near misses (Romania #11, Netherlands #12, Belgium #13) that teach something
Values and order match the Wikipedia UN 2025 table; England, UK, Turkiye and common typos all match
Gimme-heavy curve; keep it well apart from countries-population on the schedule since they share most answers
fixes: Drop non-name redirect aliases from the top 10: Germany 'The Land of Chocolate', 'Federal state', 'German infrastructure'; United Kingdom 'Topography of the UK' family; Italy 'Law and criminal justice of Italy', 'Administrative units of Italy'; Spain 'Mountains of Spain'; Kazakhstan 'Day of the Capital'

Same for extras: Finland 'Bibliography of Finland', 'Finnishness'; Ireland 'Irish politics', 'Ireland politics'; Malta 'Science and technology in Malta', 'Maltese art'; Sweden 'Swedish origin'; Greece 'Law of Greece'
